results.name: live sessions by creator
results.description: The hot path: a user's non-ended sessions. The partial index excludes the ~92% of rows that are ended, so it stays small no matter how much history accumulates.
results.query: SELECT id, status, created_at FROM sessions WHERE creator_id = (SELECT creator_id FROM sessions LIMIT 1) AND status <> 'ended' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

results.name: elevated-control review
results.description: Every session that granted remote control — the population a security review starts from, and a small minority of rows.
results.query: SELECT id, remote_control_granted_at FROM sessions WHERE remote_control_granted ORDER BY remote_control_granted_at DESC LIMIT 50

results.name: session list (covering index)
results.description: Answered from the index alone via INCLUDE columns, with no heap access at all.
results.query: SELECT status, created_at, creator_id, ended_at FROM sessions WHERE status = 'ended' AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

results.name: context history for a session
results.description: The training extract's access pattern: one session's events in time order.
results.query: SELECT foreground_app, recorded_at FROM context_events WHERE session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM context_events LIMIT 1) ORDER BY recorded_at

results.name: protected-content events
results.description: Partial index over the security-relevant minority of events.
results.query: SELECT count(*) FROM context_events WHERE (is_flag_secure_active OR is_sensitive_app) AND recorded_at > now() - interval '7 days'

results.name: partition pruning (7-day window)
results.description: A time-windowed scan should touch only the partitions that can contain matching rows, not all of them.
results.query: SELECT count(*) FROM context_events WHERE recorded_at >= CAST(:cutoff AS timestamptz) AND recorded_at < CAST(:window_end AS timestamptz)

notes: Partition pruning: 2 of 11 partitions scanned for a 7-day window (82% eliminated before execution).
Total BRIN index size across context_events partitions: 648 kB
